props.name: accessDenied
props.comment: Rendered when access is denied. Defaults to `null`.

props.name: action
props.comment: The action to check (`'list' | 'create' | 'edit' | 'show' | 'delete'` or custom).

props.name: loading
props.comment: Rendered while the access check is pending. Defaults to `null`.

props.name: record
props.comment: Optional record the grant is scoped to (record-level predicates).
